items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: A friend of mine, a friend of ours, rather, Bowden, had joined the Navy in Chicago

ctx.x: September of '42, that's right. We began losing members of the band to the Army, to the Navy, to the Air Force. A friend of mine, a friend of ours, rather, Bowden, had joined the Navy in Chicago, and he was recruiting men, musicians, for the Navy up at Great Lakes. And the old fox did a wonderful job in recruiting band boys from St. Louis. My brother Charles went, several of the other fellows in the band went.
You lost a guitar player, a trumpet player --
